channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Maison Perrier Adds Prebiotic Sparkling Line
item.description: Each can combines real fruit flavors, prebiotics and 6g of fiber with minimal sugar. The four-SKU lineup begins national distribution by early April.

item.title: Marzetti to Acquire Bachan’s BBQ Sauce
item.description: The Marzetti Company has agreed to acquire Bachan’s, a Japanese barbecue sauce brand, in a $400 million transaction. The move underscores growing demand for authentic global flavors and clean-label formulations across retail and foodservice.

item.title: Laird Superfood Enters Dairy With Protein Coffee
item.description: Laird Superfood expands beyond plant-based with a dairy-powered Protein Coffee featuring whey, milk protein and lion’s mane mushroom. The powdered blend delivers 10g of protein per serving and targets muscle recovery, satiety and cognitive support.

item.title: Arden’s Garden Debuts Sea Moss Energy Shot
item.description: Arden’s Garden introduces Sea Moss Energy, a 2oz shot blending St Lucia sea moss gel with pineapple, passion fruit, lemon and green tea. The 106mg caffeine boost is launching in more than 1,450 Publix stores as the brand builds on demand for functional wellness beverages.

item.title: V8 Expands Line With Zero Sugar Energy
item.description: V8 Energy Zero Sugar launches in three fruit-forward flavors with about the same caffeine as a cup of coffee. The line responds to sustained consumer interest in no-sugar energy drinks while broadening everyday usage occasions.

item.title: CJ Foods Names Adam Ricciardone Global CTO
item.description: CJ Foods appointed Adam Ricciardone as global chief technology officer, tapping more than 30 years of FMCG and consumer health R&D leadership.

item.title: Josie Beverages Launches US Energy Line
item.description: Josie Beverages has launched its zero-sugar, zero-calorie energy drink line in the US, positioning the brand around clean, crash-free energy. Formulated with lion’s mane, cordyceps and vitamin B12, the lineup reflects growing interest in functional ingredients beyond traditional caffeine.

item.title: Garden Veggie Adds Pickle, Salt & Vinegar
item.description: Garden Veggie Snacks expands its lineup with Dill Pickle Ranch Puffs and Salt & Vinegar Straws. The launches combine assertive flavors, avocado oil and no artificial dyes to meet evolving expectations in children’s snacking.

item.title: Seven Trends Shape Winter FancyFaire 2026
item.description: Plant-based products mature beyond analogs, jerky turns crispy and frozen moves further into premium territory. Across center store and sweets, brands pushed format, function and sensory intensity to capture what’s next.

item.title: A Tale of Two Cycles in CPG
item.description: The latest outlook points to flat volumes and cautious shoppers, yet adaptability continues to shape eating patterns and innovation. From bold flavors to store brand gains, brands that balance value and differentiation are positioned to win in 2026.
